clouddev-ide.RAILWAY_DOCKERFILE_PATH: Dockerfile for the workspace image. Keep this value.
clouddev-ide.PORT: HTTP port of the workspace gateway. Railway routes the public domain here.
clouddev-ide.CLOUDDEV_OMNIROUTE_BASE_URL: Local scoped inference proxy that coding agents call. Keep this value.
clouddev-ide.CLOUDDEV_OMNIROUTE_HOST: Private address of the OmniRoute service. Railway fills this reference.
clouddev-ide.CLOUDDEV_OMNIROUTE_PORT: Private OmniRoute dashboard and API port.
clouddev-ide.CLOUDDEV_OMNIROUTE_PROXY_PORT: Local port of the scoped inference proxy inside the workspace.
clouddev-ide.CLOUDDEV_GATEWAY_BOOTSTRAP_SECRET: Reference to the router handoff secret. The workspace uses it once to fetch its own scoped inference key.
clouddev-ide.CLOUDDEV_FORGEJO_HOST: Private address of the Forgejo service. Railway fills this reference.
clouddev-ide.GIT_PUBLIC_URL: Public Forgejo domain shown on the launchpad.
clouddev-ide.GIT_SSH_PROXY_HOST: Public TCP proxy host for Git over SSH.
clouddev-ide.GIT_SSH_PROXY_PORT: Public TCP proxy port for Git over SSH.
clouddev-ide.IDE_PRIVATE_HOST: Address the launchpad probes for workspace health.
clouddev-ide.IDE_PRIVATE_PORT: Port the launchpad probes for workspace health.
clouddev-ide.GIT_PRIVATE_HOST: Address the launchpad probes for Forgejo health.
clouddev-ide.GIT_PRIVATE_PORT: Port the launchpad probes for Forgejo health.
clouddev-ide.ROUTER_PRIVATE_HOST: Address the launchpad probes for OmniRoute health.
clouddev-ide.ROUTER_PRIVATE_PORT: Port the launchpad probes for OmniRoute health.
clouddev-ide.POSTGRES_HOST: Address the launchpad probes for PostgreSQL health. No database credential reaches the workspace.
clouddev-ide.POSTGRES_PORT: Port the launchpad probes for PostgreSQL health.

clouddev-git.PORT: HTTP port of Forgejo. Railway routes the public domain here.
clouddev-git.FORGEJO__database__DB_TYPE: Forgejo stores its data in the managed PostgreSQL service.
clouddev-git.FORGEJO__database__HOST: Private PostgreSQL address. Railway fills this reference.
clouddev-git.FORGEJO_POSTGRES_ADMIN_HOST: PostgreSQL address used once to create the dedicated Forgejo role.
clouddev-git.FORGEJO_POSTGRES_ADMIN_PORT: PostgreSQL port used once to create the dedicated Forgejo role.
clouddev-git.FORGEJO_POSTGRES_ADMIN_DATABASE: Maintenance database used once to create the Forgejo database.
clouddev-git.FORGEJO_POSTGRES_ADMIN_USER: PostgreSQL superuser reference used only for the one-time role setup.
clouddev-git.FORGEJO_POSTGRES_ADMIN_PASSWORD: PostgreSQL superuser password reference used only for the one-time role setup.
clouddev-git.FORGEJO_POSTGRES_ROLE: Dedicated PostgreSQL role that Forgejo runs as.
clouddev-git.FORGEJO_ADMIN_USERNAME: Username of the first Forgejo administrator.
clouddev-git.FORGEJO_ADMIN_EMAIL: Placeholder email of the first Forgejo administrator. Change it after first sign-in.
clouddev-git.FORGEJO__service__DISABLE_REGISTRATION: Blocks public sign-up. CloudDev AI is single-user.
clouddev-git.FORGEJO__service__REQUIRE_SIGNIN_VIEW: Requires sign-in before any repository page is visible.
clouddev-git.FORGEJO__repository__DEFAULT_PRIVATE: New repositories are private by default.
clouddev-git.FORGEJO__server__DISABLE_SSH: Keeps Git over SSH available through the TCP proxy.
clouddev-git.FORGEJO__server__START_SSH_SERVER: Runs Forgejo's built-in SSH server for Git.
clouddev-git.FORGEJO__server__SSH_LISTEN_PORT: Internal SSH port behind the Railway TCP proxy.

clouddev-router.RAILWAY_DOCKERFILE_PATH: Dockerfile for the pinned OmniRoute overlay image. Keep this value.
clouddev-router.DATA_DIR: OmniRoute data directory on the persistent router volume.
clouddev-router.PORT: Private OmniRoute port that Railway health-checks.
clouddev-router.DASHBOARD_PORT: Private OmniRoute dashboard port. The workspace proxies it after sign-in.
clouddev-router.API_HOST: Keeps the internal OmniRoute API on the loopback interface.
clouddev-router.OMNIROUTE_BASE_PATH: Path under which the workspace serves the OmniRoute dashboard.
clouddev-router.NEXT_PUBLIC_OMNIROUTE_BASE_PATH: Dashboard base path compiled into the OmniRoute web app.
clouddev-router.STORAGE_ENCRYPTION_KEY_VERSION: Version label of the OmniRoute storage encryption key.
clouddev-router.AUTH_COOKIE_SECURE: Sends the OmniRoute dashboard cookie over HTTPS only.
clouddev-router.REQUIRE_API_KEY: Every inference call must carry an OmniRoute API key.
clouddev-router.APP_LOG_LEVEL: OmniRoute log level. Warnings and errors only.
clouddev-router.APP_LOG_TO_FILE: Keeps OmniRoute logs out of files on the volume.
clouddev-router.PROXY_LOG_INCLUDE_IPS: Keeps client IP addresses out of proxy logs.
clouddev-router.ARENA_ELO_SYNC_ENABLED: Disables background downloads of public model rankings.
clouddev-router.MODELS_DEV_SYNC_ENABLED: Disables background downloads of the public model catalogue.

clouddev-postgres.DATABASE_URL: Private connection URL of the managed PostgreSQL service.
clouddev-postgres.PGDATA: PostgreSQL data directory on the persistent database volume.
clouddev-postgres.PGDATABASE: Default database name. Railway fills this reference.
clouddev-postgres.PGHOST: Private PostgreSQL address. Railway fills this reference.
clouddev-postgres.PGPASSWORD: Reference to the generated PostgreSQL password.
clouddev-postgres.PGPORT: PostgreSQL port on the private network.
clouddev-postgres.PGUSER: Reference to the PostgreSQL superuser name.
clouddev-postgres.POSTGRES_PASSWORD: Generated PostgreSQL superuser password. Railway creates a new value per deployment.
clouddev-postgres.RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_DRAINING_SECONDS: Seconds PostgreSQL gets to shut down cleanly during a redeploy.
clouddev-postgres.SSL_CERT_DAYS: Validity in days of the self-signed PostgreSQL TLS certificate.
